The Atelier

Designed to be
remembered.

Atelier Interiors creates sculptural sofas, bespoke beds, architectural dining furniture and handcrafted seating.

The collection celebrates bold silhouettes, carved detail and finishes with character. Custom orders invite each client to shape the piece around their own home.
